text:
marta: Heads up — main is red after today's dep bump. Lots of async integration tests timing out in the runners. Stopping merges until we triage. https://buildkite.com/redwood/ci/builds/12345
ci-bot: Build #12345 failed (integration-async) — 24 failures. Example failing test: tests/integration/test_streaming.py::test_backpressure — timeout
anika: :eyes: can you paste the stack for one of the timeouts?
marta: sure, here's the top of the failure:
```
E       asyncio.exceptions.TimeoutError
>       during await of <coroutine object StreamingClient._read at 0x7f8b2c1a7a60>
E       while executing fixture 'client'
E       assert False

tests/integration/test_streaming.py:42: AssertionError
```
kai: we bumped `pytest-asyncio` from 0.20.3 -> 0.21.0 in the lockfile this morning (dependabot).
leo: interesting — 0.21 had some changes around event loop fixture behavior. Could be that our tests rely on old semantics.
shawn: can someone try a quick revert of that single lockfile change and run `tox -e py38-integration` locally? should be fast to validate.
anika: if it's the event loop fixture, a minimal repro is running that one test with `pytest -k test_backpressure -q` and `-s`. also try `PYTEST_ADDOPTS="-s"` to see coroutine traces.
marta: i'm going to pin `pytest-asyncio==0.20.3` in poetry.lock and push a PR to unblock CI; if that fixes it, we can open an issue upstream and add a test shim.
ci-bot: Triggered rerun -> Build #12346 (by marta)
ci-bot: Build #12346 started — running integration-async suite
kai: FYI these failures were reproducing only on Linux runners in my quick local docker run; macOS runners looked different. not sure if platform-skew plays a role but initial stack is consistent.
leo: if pin fixes it, we'll want a follow-up to either adapt tests to new fixture semantics or vendor a tiny compatibility helper in our testutils.
shawn: i'll try a local bisect: checkout main~3 and apply only the bump commit to see which commit introduced failure.
anika: if rerun still fails after pin, add `pytest.mark.timeout` to narrow the coroutine that's stuck and post the loopstack.
marta: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6789 — temporary pin of pytest-asyncio to 0.20.3. tagging @eng-oncall for awareness.
ci-bot: Build #12346 passed :tada: — integration-async suite green
anika: :thumbsup: great. i'll open an upstream issue with a short repro and add notes in the PR about next steps (adapt tests or add shim).
marta: thanks all — leaving the PR up until we have a long-term fix. Once we have the upstream ticket i'll link it in the PR and schedule a follow-up to remove the pin.
